resources.string: ✨ Polishing… tap the mic to skip
Voice edit needs AI — open FlowKey → Settings → AI
Voice edit uses the Whisper engine — turn off streaming
Not available in password or private fields
A voice-only keyboard. Speech is recognized on the phone — no account, no cloud. Four steps and you\'re dictating.
Higher-accuracy Whisper small loaded ✓ (99 languages + auto-detect)
Microphone access is required for dictation
FlowKey is not enabled yet — turn it on in system settings
Pick FlowKey in the keyboard chooser. You can switch back any time with the globe key.
Live text (Whisper): words appear while you speak
Works in every language. Each phrase is finished when you pause for a second. Turn off to transcribe once at the end (lighter on slow phones).
Not used while English streaming mode is on: streaming is always live.
Unavailable: this build has no voice detector (assets/vad/silero_vad.onnx).

The streaming model crashed FlowKey while loading, so FlowKey switched back to the Whisper engine. Dictation works normally. If you copied your own streaming model, check that it is the one listed in MODELS.md.
Default engine is multilingual Whisper (any language you add, plus auto-detect). English streaming mode uses a separate English-only engine that is the fastest, and boosts your words.
Tap here, switch to FlowKey with the chooser, then dictate…
Always replace a misheard word with your correction.

The higher-accuracy model crashed FlowKey while loading, most likely because the phone ran out of memory. FlowKey switched back to the built-in model. You can turn the higher-accuracy model on again in Setup to retry.
The English streaming engine crashed while loading your words, so it now runs without them. Streaming itself stays on. Edit your words to try again.
The language key cycles AUTO and these. Add any of 99 languages — no download needed.
Added %1$s — tap the language key to switch to it.
Whisper small (~375 MB download, ~2–3× slower). Most useful for languages the built-in model handles less well. Optional — FlowKey works without it.
Downloading… %1$d of %2$d MB. Keep this screen open.

About 375 MB from huggingface.co. Use Wi-Fi and keep this screen open; an interrupted download resumes where it stopped. This is the only thing FlowKey ever downloads, and your audio never leaves the phone.
Delete the higher-accuracy model (~375 MB)? FlowKey goes back to the built-in model.
Download failed: the phone storage is not available.
Download failed: not enough free space (needs %1$s).
Download failed (%1$s). Check the connection and tap Resume.
The downloaded file was damaged (%1$s) and was deleted. Tap Download to try again.
Names, brands and jargon. FlowKey fixes their spelling in what you dictate, and the English streaming engine listens for them.
Already in the list, or the list is full (200 words).
Say a trigger phrase to insert a longer text.
Say \"comma\", \"čárka\", \"virgule\"… in English, Czech, Slovak, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Polish and Dutch.
Your last 50 transcripts, stored only on this device.
Tap an entry to copy it.

FlowKey needs the multilingual Whisper model (three files):

1. On a computer, download:
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-whisper-base.tar.bz2
(for better quality, use "Extra: higher-accuracy model" in Setup instead — do NOT use a ".en" variant)

2. Extract it and copy these three files:
• *-encoder.int8.onnx
• *-decoder.int8.onnx
• *-tokens.txt

3. Connect the phone via USB and place them in:
%1$s

4. Come back and tap Re-check.

Full details: MODELS.md in the project folder.

Streaming mode needs the English streaming Zipformer model:

1. On a computer, download:
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-streaming-zipformer-en-2023-06-26.tar.bz2

2. Extract and copy these four files:
• encoder-*.int8.onnx
• decoder-*.onnx
• joiner-*.int8.onnx
• tokens.txt

3. Connect the phone via USB and place them in:
%1$s

4. Come back and tap Re-check.

Full details: MODELS.md in the project folder.
